text:
Dicotyledon group. Petrels overture
+from it, propensities of trinity,
+endings that begin, ohs born of ayes
+one might think bevalued with heterogeneity.
+Group of the cotyledons!
+
+Let us see. Let that be, without being more.
+Let us see. Let it not transcend outward,
+and let it think as if not to be heard,
+and chrome itself and not be seen.
+And let it not gliss in the great collapse.
+
+The created voice rebels and refuses
+to be mesh, or love.
+Let bride and groom be bride and groom in eternity.
+For do not give 1, which will resound to infinity.
+And do not give 0, which will fall so silent
+until it wakes and sets 1 upright.
+
+Ah bicardiac group.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem V — Dicotyledon Group
translation.editorial_note: Vallejo’s verbs are recreated rather than regularized: petrels overture, forms bevalue, bodies chrome and gliss; the botanical pair becomes a two-hearted arithmetic of lovers.
